facts.fact_text: A demonstration was planned to be held on 12 March 2011 in Baku.
According to the applicant, the demonstration was intended to be peaceful.
According to the applicant, the demonstration was conducted in a peaceful manner.
The participants of the demonstration were protesting against, inter alia, corruption.
The participants of the demonstration were demanding the resignation of the President of the State.
The applicant attended the demonstration on 12 March 2011 in Baku.
Shortly after the demonstration had begun, the police started to disperse those who had gathered.
The applicant was arrested during the police dispersal operation.
After his arrest, the applicant was taken to three different police stations consecutively.

By a decision of 12 March 2011, the Sabail District Court convicted the applicant under Article 310.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences (failure to comply with a lawful order of a police officer).
The Sabail District Court sentenced the applicant to eight days' administrative detention by its decision of 12 March 2011.

By a decision of 12 April 2011, the Sabail District Court convicted the applicant under Article 310.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences (failure to comply with a lawful order of a police officer).
The Sabail District Court sentenced the applicant to seven days' administrative detention by its decision of 12 April 2011.
The applicant was charged with an administrative offence under Article 298 of the Code of Administrative Offences (violation of the rules on holding public assemblies).
The applicant was charged with an administrative offence under Article 310.1 of the Code of Administrative Offences (failure to comply with a lawful order of a police officer).

At the material time, Article 410.4 of the Code of Administrative Offences 2000 provided that an individual who is subject to administrative-offence proceedings or a representative of a legal entity has the right to a copy of the administrative-offence report.

The Baku City Executive Authority (BCEA) refused to authorise the demonstration at the place indicated by the organisers.

The Baku City Executive Authority (BCEA) proposed a different location for the demonstration on the outskirts of Baku — the grounds of a driving school situated in the 20th habitable area of the Sabail District.
The organisers decided to hold the demonstration in the centre of Baku despite the Baku City Executive Authority's refusal to authorise the originally indicated location.

The applicant was arrested during the police dispersal operation.
According to the applicant, he was not given access to a lawyer after his arrest.
According to the applicant, he was not given access to a lawyer while he was in police custody.
None of the material submitted to the Court contains any record showing that the State-funded lawyer, Mr E.N., made any oral submissions on behalf of the applicant.
None of the material submitted to the Court contains any record showing that the State-funded lawyer, Mr E.N., made any written submissions on behalf of the applicant.
No witnesses were questioned during the court hearing before the Sabail District Court on 12 March 2011.

The Baku Court of Appeal held that the case file contained only a photocopy and not the original of the report prepared by police officers M.A. and H.A., and therefore it had not been possible to order its expert examination.
The Baku Court of Appeal did not address the applicant's requests to summon and examine witnesses Mr A.H., Mr A.M. and Mr R.M. on his behalf.
The Baku Court of Appeal did not address the applicant's request to examine the video recordings made by Mr A.H.
According to the applicant, during the re-examination of the case he was not given an opportunity to appoint a lawyer of his own choosing.
A State-funded lawyer was appointed to assist the applicant during the re-examination of the case before the Sabail District Court on 12 April 2011.
The only witnesses questioned during the re-examination hearing before the Sabail District Court on 12 April 2011 were police officers M.A. and E.G.

Police officer E.G. testified at the re-examination hearing that he had prepared the administrative-offence report in respect of the applicant.
